top_signals.title: Greenland Warns Trump-Linked Firm over Unauthorized Drilling Plan
top_signals.summary: A Texas-based oil company chaired by an entrepreneur thought to be close to U.S. President Donald Trump is moving drilling equipment in Greenland in preparation for an oil drilling campaign. However, the drilling plans or the moving of the equipment have not been authorized by the Greenland authorities yet, although a process to do so is under review at present. top_signals.title: J.B. Hunt celebrates 65 years, rings Nasdaq opening bell
